parties.respondent: Institute Of Banking Personnel Selection & ORS

summary: Facilities for disabled candidates in competitive exams; PwD status under RPwD Act, 2016; benchmark disability not mandatory for scribe/extra time; precedent from Vikas Kumar case; writ petition challenging exclusionary practice; maintainability against IBPS; respondents' compliance status; order clarifying non-insistence on benchmark disability; writ allowed to standardize policy.
legal_provisions_cited: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
final_judgment: Writ petition partly allowed; clarification issued regarding non-insistence on benchmark disability for scribe facility; respondents directed to incorporate provisions for all disabled candidates as per Office Memorandum dated 10.08.2022 by Respondent No.5.
